title: BSU hosted a meeting with a representative of the Russkiy Mir Foundation

blocks.text: A meeting with the head of the department for providing Russian centers of the Russian World Foundation, Nikolai Konstantinovich Sergeev, was held at the Bishkek State University named after Academician K. Karasaev.

During the meeting, issues of strengthening cooperation between the Foundation and the University, directions for further development of the Russian Center, as well as joint educational and cultural initiatives aimed at popularizing the Russian language and literature were discussed.

The meeting was attended by the rector of BSU, Professor Dyldaev Mirlan Muktarovich, Dean of the Faculty of Russian Philology Niyazalieva Rakhat Anarbekovna, Deputy Head of the Russian Center of the Russian World Foundation at BSU, Professor Svetlana Aleksandrovna Elebesova, as well as teachers of the Faculty of Russian Philology.
The guests expressed mutual interest in continuing fruitful cooperation, implementing joint projects and strengthening humanitarian ties.
